Name: Neck,Head
Description: This will create a Neck and a Head System (v003: neck joints start on the Neck guide, matrix based for faster playback, squash and stretch, Default/SN orients)

attrs.Help_string:
Overview:
  This will create a Neck and a Head System.

How To Use:
  fill the key fields below before build.

Fields:
- SetParent: set the target node name.
- If left as default, the tool uses placeholder behavior for setup.
- HeadCtrlType: choose one option (for example: octagon, hexagon, square, sphere).
- Ribbon: ON adds one sub controller per neck joint (Neck_1_Ctrl...), shown with Neck_Ctrl Vis.
- SecundaryRibbon: how many neck joints (default 3). The first one sits on the Neck guide, Head_Bnd on the Head guide.
- CtrlSize: numeric value that controls size/amount/intensity (default 4).
- CtrlColor: choose one option (for example: yellow, lightBlue, blue, white).
- SquashStretch: adds Volume on Neck_Ctrl, the neck gets thinner when it stretches and thicker when it squashes.
- Orients: Default keeps Neck_Ctrl along the neck, SN aligns the neck controllers to the world like the spine and uses xzy rotate orders on Neck_Ctrl / Head_Ctrl.
- Neck_Ctrl Stretch: 1 lets Head_Ctrl stretch the neck, 0 keeps the neck length (the head joint stays on the line to Head_Ctrl).
- Neck_Ctrl Bend: how much of the head swing the neck joints take, more near the head (0 = like v002).
- Template parent examples: Head_Jnt, L_Hand_Ankle_Jnt, Head_Ctrl.

Tips:
- if a field says left/right or mirror, use it to generate the opposite side quickly.
